subject: prd/installer
statement: If git user identity (user.name / user.email) is unset at every level when init must create a commit, then the system shall establish a repo-local identity from the wizard's answers, or refuse with a named remediation — never attempt a commit that will fail
intent: identity established, or the named remediation
fit_criterion: identity-unset fixtures either produce a working repo-local identity or the named refusal; no failed-commit state is left behind
